summary: "Whatever U Like" is a song by American recording artist Nicole Scherzinger featuring rapper T.I. The song was composed by Scherzinger, T.I., Sean Garrett and Polow da Don for Scherzinger's planned debut studio album "Her Name Is Nicole". Interscope Records released it as Scherzinger's solo debut single on July 30, 2007.
one_line: A 2007 song by Nicole Scherzinger featuring T.I., released by Interscope Records as her solo debut single.
